mentions.name: ChangeWord
mentions.description: A multilingual word ladder game with golf scoring mechanics, playable in English, Spanish, French, German, Dutch and Swedish, with generated word-list puzzles.
mentions.problem: The author's previous word games were exclusively in English; this game adds multilingual support.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I am working on my first multilingual word game: https://changeword.org

My previous games have all been exclusively in English, but this one also has Spanish, French, German, Dutch and Swedish. It's a take on the classic word ladder game, with golf scoring mechanics.
